```{r}
ACAD_vis <- read_csv('../data/visitation/ACAD.csv')
names(ACAD_vis)[14] <- "Year_Tot"
ACAD_vis$Park = "ACAD"

BIBE_vis <- read_csv('../data/visitation/BIBE.csv')
names(BIBE_vis)[14] <- "Year_Tot"
BIBE_vis$Park = "BIBE"

JOTR_vis <- read_csv('../data/visitation/JOTR.csv')
names(JOTR_vis)[14] <- "Year_Tot"
JOTR_vis$Park = "JOTR"


full <- rbind(ACAD_vis, BIBE_vis, JOTR_vis)
ggplot(ACAD_vis, aes(x = Year, y = Year_Tot)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "ACAD yearly"
  )

ggplot(BIBE_vis, aes(x = Year, y = Year_Tot)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "BIBE yearly"
  )

ggplot(full, aes(x=Year, y=Year_Tot, color = Park)) +
  geom_line()
  
```
